svg.text: Mercenaries 2 renderer — frame flow and MC2VR hook points
one main thread · D3D9 (DXVK) · producer → opaque VM stub → plaintext consumer · camera exists only as GPU constants
FRAME CONSUMER (render task → D3D device calls)
main loop tick · GameStateStack_Update → InGameShellState_Update → RunFrame
~114 subsystem updates: world · physics · audio · UI · tasks
walks active-view list → 1 element per view {camera staging · ViewEntry* · frame ctx}
consumer reads it AFTER the walk
opaque: builds draw records · view contexts · materials · command streams
native glue in Stext calls plaintext (callbacks) — never hook the stub itself
on each SetVertexShaderConstantF upload, main pass only (RT0 == backbuffer size):
VP rows 0-3: w -= dot(row.xyz, D) camPos: xyz += D (D = ± right · IPD/2)
exact registers from the technique (upload-gate MidHook) · rewrite on a scratch copy
shadow / reflection / offscreen passes are NOT shifted (their RT0 size differs)
Present(prev) → BeginScene → GPU EVENT-QUERY SYNC (waits for all prior work) → Clear
pass changes: main / shadow atlas / reflections / half-res chain
(only re-uploaded when view-context index or technique changes)
material texgen matrix · view record · screen consts
(NOT hooked: PS camera data & texgen stay mono — open item)
state · textures · RT switches · direct VS-constant uploads (op 0x02 → slot 94)
PLANNED (S2c): replay this loop once per eye
buffer the command stream · eye render targets · per-eye constants from the rewrite above
plaintext called back by the stub
Facts: the draw camera never exists in patchable plaintext data — it reaches the GPU only as the viewContextData VS constants, so per-eye injection is at SetVertexShaderConstantF.

Sources: docs/reverse_engineering/render_path.md (frame chain, stub callbacks) · docs/stereo_design.md (camera channel, hook inventory) · Ghidra plates on PgPrimitive_SubmitToGPU / g_ViewContextTable.
